The hexagonal network remains recognizable without the detached downward arrow. The arrow occupies its empty lower center as a download action rather than a physical network connection.

## Visual draft

Three rounded hexagons form a triangular network around an open center. A downward arrow occupies the lower middle above a shallow V shaped boundary, with short connection lines extending beside the upper node.

## 1. Three hexagon network (solo)

Three rounded hexagonal nodes form a triangular network with short upper connectors and a shallow V shaped lower boundary. Exclude the downward arrow.

## 2. Downward open arrow (sub)

A straight upright shaft ends in two diagonal arms forming an open downward arrowhead. Exclude all network nodes and boundary lines.
